title: Weekly Email Digest Notification Settings
purpose: Document the requested weekly email digest notification preference behaviors.

scope.text: The requested scope covers four behaviors: members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings; the setting persists after sign-out and sign-in; switching digests off does not disable account-security messages; new members start with weekly digests off.

requirements.text: Members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
The setting must persist after sign-out and sign-in.
Switching digests off does not disable account-security messages.
A newly created member starts with weekly digests off.

stories.text: As a member, I want to switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member is viewing notification settings, when the member switches weekly email digests on or off, then the selected value is stored and reflected in the setting.

stories.text: As a member, I want my weekly email digest setting to persist after sign-out and sign-in.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member has saved a weekly email digest setting, when the member signs out and then signs back in and opens notification settings, then the displayed setting matches the saved value.

stories.text: As a member, I want switching off weekly email digests not to disable account-security messages.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member has switched weekly email digests off, when an account-security message would be sent under existing security-message policy, then the account-security message is still sent to the member.

stories.text: As a new member, I want to start with weekly email digests off.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new member account is created, when the member first views notification settings, then the weekly email digest setting is off.

dependencies.text: Owner and delivery date are unknown.

risks.text: Owner and delivery date are unknown; scheduling and accountability for this feature remain unresolved.

success_metrics.text: After implementation, verify that each acceptance criterion in STORY-1 through STORY-4 can be demonstrated.

open_questions: Who owns the weekly email digest preference feature?
What is the delivery date for the weekly email digest preference behaviors?
